reviewContext.note: No manifest.json was present at reviews/impl/iteration-1/input/ -- this review was scoped directly from the launching agent's instructions against specs/behavioral-spec.md + specs/verification-architecture.md.

toolConstraintNote: No shell/execute tool was available in this review session (Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob only) -- claims below are established by direct static tracing of deterministic, non-I/O-dependent logic (string matching, boolean/ternary field propagation, file existence via Glob), not by executing `node --test` or `curl`. Every finding is falsifiable by re-reading the cited file:line.

evidence.description: REQ-001's EVM identity resolution (unset ANICCA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY, resolve-identity.mjs evm CLI call, export under $PKVAR) is implemented correctly and verified by static trace -- this is the one clean part of the feature.

findings.issue: Identity-match guard (root-cause-3 fix) is trivially bypassed by an ambient ANICCA_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY env var, because run.sh never unsets it before either wallet-address-solana.mjs call (unlike earn/run.sh, which correctly unsets ANICCA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY). resolveSolanaSecret's env override (resolve-identity.mjs:118-120) ignores ANICCA_HOME entirely, so OWN_WALLET and CLI_WALLET become identical for ANY instance whenever that var is set -- defeating the guard for every non-Franklin instance, not just Franklin.

The spec-mandated new pure module parse-pass.mjs is missing from disk entirely. Its own test file (__tests__/parse-pass.test.mjs) imports it and will crash with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on any `node --test` run. PROP-010 cannot be passing as shipped.

Inline sed/grep signature extraction (never calls the promised parse-pass.mjs, which doesn't exist) takes the FIRST 'Signature:' occurrence via `head -1`, contradicting REQ-002's explicit edge case and PROP-010 which both require the LAST occurrence on a multi-step swap chain -- corrupting recorded P&L on multi-leg passes.

Hardcodes external:true on every recorded line, directly contradicting REQ-002's explicit edge case ('external is never set by this wiring') and the feature's OWN test (record-swap.test.mjs:116-122 asserts external must NOT be true and isProfitable must be false) -- ledger.mjs's isProfitable() will actually return true for a winning sol-trade line since 'sol-trade' is not in SWAP_SOURCES, incorrectly granting GATE-0 to an internal same-wallet swap.

No bash integration test exists for sol-trade/run.sh's full pass boundary (PROP-011 through PROP-016 required:true full-integration ACs) -- no fixture ANICCA_HOME shapes, no franklin-trading PATH-stub, no fake_solana_rpc.mjs-style RPC stub anywhere in the repo. The identity-match guard, cumulative earn-guard wiring, and RPC-failure degrade are unverified at the level that actually matters.

EARN_ALLOW allowlist still sources BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY (automaton's key) into the process env; currently harmless only due to export-ordering at line 54, with no test enforcing that ordering invariant.

record-swap.mjs's returned status is never parsed/branched on -- no narrate-only 'sol-verify-failed:<reason>' degrade line is ever appended per REQ-002/PROP-016 when the RPC verify step errors. A real swap whose verify call flakes leaves zero ledger trace, reproducing the P&L-invisibility bug (root cause 2) this feature exists to fix.
